en: Exodus 36

p.src: 1  “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom the LORD has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD has commanded.”

ja: ベツァルエル、オホリアブ、および
en: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom the LORD has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD has commanded.”
u.src: 1  “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom the LORD has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD has commanded.”

p.src: 2  Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.

ja: モーセはベツァルエルとオホリアブ、また
に携わろうとする者たちをみな
en: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.
u.src: 2  Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.

p.src: 3  They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.

ja: らは、イスラエルの子らが聖所の奉仕の仕事のために
en: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.
u.src: 3  They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.

p.src: 4  All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.

en: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.
u.src: 4  All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.

p.src: 5  They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which the LORD commanded to make.”

ja: えて持って来ています。」
en: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which the LORD commanded to make.”
u.src: 5  They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which the LORD commanded to make.”

p.src: 6  Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.

ja: ってはならない。」こうして
en: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.
u.src: 6  Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.

p.src: 7  For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.

en: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.
u.src: 7  For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.

p.src: 8  All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

ja: を造った。彼らはケルビムを熟練した職人の細工としてこれらに
en: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.
u.src: 8  All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

p.src: 9  The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.

ja: キュビトとした。すべての
en: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.
u.src: 9  The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.

ja: 36:9 一キュビトは、大人の腕の中指の先から肘までの長さで、約18インチ、すなわち約46センチメートルである。
en: 36:9 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.

p.src: 10  He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.

en: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.
u.src: 10  He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.

p.src: 11  He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.

en: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.
u.src: 11  He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.

p.src: 12  He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.

en: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.
u.src: 12  He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.

p.src: 13  He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.

ja: わせた。こうして幕屋は
en: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.
u.src: 13  He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.

p.src: 14  He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.

en: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.
u.src: 14  He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.

p.src: 15  The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.

en: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.
u.src: 15  The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.

p.src: 16  He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

en: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
u.src: 16  He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

p.src: 17  He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.

en: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.
u.src: 17  He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.

p.src: 18  He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.

en: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.
u.src: 18  He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.

p.src: 19  He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

en: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
u.src: 19  He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

p.src: 20  He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.

ja: のためにアカシアの木で
en: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.
u.src: 20  He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.

p.src: 21  Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.

ja: キュビト、それぞれの板の
en: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.
u.src: 21  Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.

p.src: 22  Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.

ja: には、互いに合うように
つのほぞがあった。彼は
en: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.
u.src: 22  Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.

p.src: 23  He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

en: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.
u.src: 23  He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

p.src: 24  He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

en: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
u.src: 24  He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

p.src: 25  For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards

en: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards
u.src: 25  For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards

p.src: 26  and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

en: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
u.src: 26  and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

p.src: 27  For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

en: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
u.src: 27  For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

p.src: 28  He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.

en: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.
u.src: 28  He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.

p.src: 29  They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.

ja: になり、同じように頂部でも
つの環に向けて一つとなるようにした。彼は
にある両方の板をそのようにした。
en: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.
u.src: 29  They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.

p.src: 30  There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.

ja: の台座となった。すべての
en: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.
u.src: 30  There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.

p.src: 31  He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

en: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
u.src: 31  He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

p.src: 32  and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.

en: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.
u.src: 32  and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.

p.src: 33  He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.

ja: 彼は板の真ん中を通る
en: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.
u.src: 33  He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.

p.src: 34  He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

en: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
u.src: 34  He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

p.src: 35  He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.

ja: を造った。それにケルビムを熟練した職人の細工として
en: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.
u.src: 35  He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.

p.src: 36  He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.

ja: そのために四本のアカシアの木の
をかぶせた。その掛け釘は
であった。彼はそのために四つの
en: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.
u.src: 36  He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.

p.src: 37  He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;

ja: 彼は天幕の入り口のために、
をする者の細工による
en: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;
u.src: 37  He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;

p.src: 38  and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.

ja: とその掛け釘を造り、その
飾りに金をかぶせた。その
en: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.
u.src: 38  and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.
